items.text: Pin the checkpoint, tokenizer, adapter, prompt, runtime, and policy as one release bundle.
Reserve explicit token budgets for instructions, evidence, history, tools, and output.
Preserve source identity, authorization, freshness, and claim-level support.
Keep consequential tools behind least privilege, validation, idempotency, and required approval.
Test which instruction or evidence is lost when the context budget is exceeded.
Define visible degraded behavior for missing retrieval, policy, validator, and tool dependencies.
Measure queue, first-token, output-token, memory, and cancellation behavior across real request shapes.
Keep the previous proven bundle runnable and rehearse rollback plus request reconciliation.
